bar.name: Bar
bar.basis: Dollars per 30 days at full utilisation: about 400 drinks a day at roughly 0.65 average over the bar plus spirits; a middling bar runs near half of this. Rent is the ordinary bar lease.

diner.name: Diner
diner.basis: About 250 covers a day at roughly 1.75 a check (breakfast and lunch average) over 30 days at full utilisation.

pizzeria.name: Pizzeria
pizzeria.basis: About 220 customers a day at roughly 2.60, the low end of the restaurant meal range for a counter and takeaway trade, over 30 days at full utilisation.

social_club.name: Social Club
social_club.basis: Members' drinks, cards, small dues and the occasional function; a small room that does not sell to the street, so far below a bar of the same size.

nightclub.name: Nightclub
nightclub.basis: About 400 patrons a night at roughly 7 each (cover, drinks, supper) over 26 working nights at full utilisation.

trucking_firm.name: Trucking Firm
trucking_firm.basis: A small fleet of about four trucks at roughly 5,500 a truck a month at full utilisation, with drivers at the freight wage range.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.basis: Storage and handling fees of about five to six times the monthly lease of an ordinary warehouse at full utilisation.

car_dealership.name: Car Dealership
car_dealership.basis: About 30 used cars a month at roughly 2,000 at full utilisation; the high cost ratio is the price of the stock sold.

construction_firm.name: Construction Firm
construction_firm.basis: A crew of about six trades at the building wage range billed at roughly twice wage cost, plus materials, over 30 days at full utilisation.

laundromat.name: Laundromat
laundromat.basis: About 400 loads a day at roughly 0.75 including dryers over 30 days at full utilisation.

vending_route.name: Vending Route
vending_route.basis: About 60 machines at roughly 100 a month each (cigarettes, coffee, candy, jukebox and pinball) at full utilisation; the route driver and the product are most of the cost.

numbers_bank.name: Numbers Bank
numbers_bank.basis: Gross handle of roughly 2,000 a day over 30 days at full utilisation. The cost ratio follows bible section 7.1: winning hits take most of the handle and the runners and controller the rest, leaving a net take of ten to fifteen percent. Not derived from the price ledger.

sports_book.name: Sports Book
sports_book.basis: Gross handle of roughly 3,000 a day over 30 days at full utilisation. The cost ratio follows bible section 7.1: with 11-to-10 pricing the winners are paid from the losers' money and the book keeps about five percent of balanced handle. Not derived from the price ledger.

bakery.name: Bakery
bakery.basis: About 350 customers a day at roughly 1.30 (bread, rolls and pastry) over 30 days at full utilisation.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.basis: About 200 customers a day at roughly 2.75 over 30 days at full utilisation; meat prices are not in the ledger, so the average is an assumption scaled from the grocery rows.

funeral_home.name: Funeral Home
funeral_home.basis: About 14 services a month at roughly 1,150 each at full utilisation. The average is the 1980 median adult funeral (about 1,800, outside the ledger and recalled) scaled by the goods ratio; assumption.

union_local_office.name: Union Local Office
union_local_office.basis: About 800 members paying about 15 a month in dues (a little over one percent of a trades or freight wage) at full utilisation; staff, the hall and pension and welfare administration are most of the cost.
